prompt: Help me turn this into a proper user story: implement 404 handling for PDP routes, rules should match AEM

assertions.text: Output contains the APPROVED STORY header block
Story follows 'As a [persona], I want [goal], so that [reason]' format
assertions.check: output contains 'Story: As a' and 'I want' and 'so that'
output does NOT contain 'Given' or 'When' or 'Then' (case-insensitive, in context of acceptance criteria)

assertions.text: Pipeline labels are present ([STORY WRITER] and [TECH LEAD])
AEM 404 rules are concretely defined in acceptance criteria (SKU invalid/unpublished/out-of-market)
assertions.check: output references specific 404 conditions (invalid SKU, unpublished, or out-of-market) rather than vague 'match AEM rules'
